New Delhi

Professional Summary
Senior front-end developer specializing in Angular-based applications with strong TypeScript and CSS skills. Experienced in delivering responsive, component-driven user interfaces for finance and healthcare platforms, collaborating with cross-functional teams using Agile tools.

Technical Skills
Angular, TypeScript, CSS, Sass, Jira, Confluence

Work Experience
Senior Angular Developer, Zentrix Labs (May 2023 - Present)
- Led development of a modular Angular component library used across three enterprise products, improving UI consistency and reducing development time; major work included Angular and TypeScript implementation and CSS theming.
- Implemented performance optimizations in a client dashboard, decreasing initial load time by 35% through lazy loading and ChangeDetectionStrategy adjustments using TypeScript and Angular; refined responsive layouts with CSS.
- Collaborated with product and QA teams via Jira and Confluence to scope and track biweekly sprints and document design systems; mentored two junior engineers on Angular and TypeScript best practices.

Frontend Engineer, Saffron Bank (May 2022 - Apr 2023)
- Rebuilt customer-facing transaction pages using Angular and TypeScript, improving transaction throughput handling and reducing client-reported issues by 28%; styled complex widgets with CSS and Sass.
- Developed accessible form components and validated interactions across browsers, integrating form validation logic in TypeScript and responsive styles with Sass and CSS.
- Coordinated feature delivery and bug triage using Jira and documented release notes and runbooks in Confluence.

Frontend Engineer, Medisure (Sep 2018 - Apr 2022)
- Implemented core modules of a healthcare provider portal using Angular, building reusable components for scheduling and patient records and styling them with CSS.
- Enhanced UI responsiveness and reduced layout regressions by standardizing CSS patterns and introducing component-level styles within Angular.
- Participated in sprint planning and maintained task tracking in Jira and Confluence while collaborating with backend and QA teams to deliver iterative releases.

Education
B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
